text:
REASON: The reviewer correctly identifies the fatal flaw that churn was measured only on accounts older than 12 months, which excludes early churners and artificially inflates LTV for new acquisitions, treating it as a critical failure that must be fixed. The final recommendation is a "NO-GO" on the current plan with a conditional capped pilot, which constitutes a rejection of the proposal as written but not a complete abandonment of the idea, so it is blocked but not killed.
FLAW_CAUGHT: 1
KILLED: 0
BLOCKED: 1
